## Overview

Connect to the AgentProxy MCP server (110 tools, 3 transports: SSE/stdio/HTTP). Covers routing, cache, compression, memory, skills, providers, and audit tools across 33 permission scopes.

## Authentication

All requests require a valid Bearer token or session cookie. Obtain a token via `POST /api/auth/login` or configure `REQUIRE_API_KEY=false` for local development.

## Endpoints

### GET /api/mcp/audit

GET mcp › audit

```bash
curl https://localhost:20128/api/mcp/audit \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $AGENTPROXY_TOKEN"
```

### GET /api/mcp/audit/stats

GET mcp › audit › stats

```bash
curl https://localhost:20128/api/mcp/audit/stats \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $AGENTPROXY_TOKEN"
```

### GET /api/mcp/sse

GET mcp › sse

```bash
curl https://localhost:20128/api/mcp/sse \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $AGENTPROXY_TOKEN"
```

### POST /api/mcp/sse

POST mcp › sse

```bash
curl -X POST https://localhost:20128/api/mcp/sse \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $AGENTPROXY_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{}'
```

### GET /api/mcp/status

GET mcp › status

```bash
curl https://localhost:20128/api/mcp/status \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $AGENTPROXY_TOKEN"
```

### GET /api/mcp/stream

GET mcp › stream

```bash
curl https://localhost:20128/api/mcp/stream \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $AGENTPROXY_TOKEN"
```

### POST /api/mcp/stream

POST mcp › stream

```bash
curl -X POST https://localhost:20128/api/mcp/stream \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $AGENTPROXY_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{}'
```

### DELETE /api/mcp/stream

DELETE mcp › stream

```bash
curl -X DELETE https://localhost:20128/api/mcp/stream \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $AGENTPROXY_TOKEN"
```

### GET /api/mcp/tools

GET mcp › tools

```bash
curl https://localhost:20128/api/mcp/tools \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $AGENTPROXY_TOKEN"
```

# AgentProxy — MCP Server

Requires `AGENTPROXY_URL` and `AGENTPROXY_KEY`. See [entry-point SKILL](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khanhkit/AgentProxy/main/skills/agentproxy/SKILL.md) for setup.

## Transports

- **stdio** — local IPC, for Claude Desktop / VS Code extensions
- **SSE** — `GET $AGENTPROXY_URL/api/mcp/sse`
- **Streamable HTTP** — `POST $AGENTPROXY_URL/api/mcp/stream`

## Claude Desktop config

Add to `~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json`:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "agentproxy": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "agentproxy", "--mcp"],
      "env": { "AGENTPROXY_KEY": "sk-..." }
    }
  }
}
```

## Cursor / VS Code config

```json
{
  "mcp": {
    "servers": {
      "agentproxy": {
        "url": "http://localhost:20128/api/mcp/sse",
        "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer sk-..." }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Core tool examples (live catalog: 110 tools)

The table below shows representative core tools; the server's discovery response is authoritative and includes all 110 tools.

| Scope     | Tools                                                                                              |
| --------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| health    | `agentproxy_get_health`                                                                             |
| combos    | `agentproxy_list_combos`, `agentproxy_get_combo_metrics`, `agentproxy_switch_combo`                   |
| routing   | `agentproxy_simulate_route`, `agentproxy_best_combo_for_task`, `agentproxy_explain_route`             |
| providers | `agentproxy_get_provider_metrics`, `agentproxy_check_quota`, `agentproxy_route_request`               |
| budget    | `agentproxy_set_budget_guard`, `agentproxy_set_routing_strategy`, `agentproxy_set_resilience_profile` |
| testing   | `agentproxy_test_combo`                                                                             |
| memory    | `memory_add`, `memory_search`, `memory_delete`                                                     |
| skills    | `skill_invoke`, `skill_list`, `skill_describe`, `skill_register`                                   |
| cache     | `agentproxy_cache_stats`, `agentproxy_cache_flush`                                                   |
| admin     | `agentproxy_db_health_check`, `agentproxy_sync_pricing`, `agentproxy_get_session_snapshot`            |

Full list: `GET $AGENTPROXY_URL/api/mcp/tools`

## Scopes

Tools are grouped into 33 scopes (chat-only, memory-readonly, full-admin, etc.).
Pass scope name as `--scope` arg or via `X-AgentProxy-Scope` header.
